Metric Definitions

SQO Rate
% of delivered pieces that became SQOs.
SQOs ÷ Delivered × 100
Penetration %
% of CRM named accounts in the segment that were mailed.
Mailed ÷ CRM Total × 100
Potential SQOs
Estimated SQOs from untapped accounts at current SQO rate.
Untapped × SQO Rate
Cost / SQO
Effective spend per opportunity generated in this segment.
(Delivered × Cost/piece) ÷ SQOs
Account vs. Contact Level
Account SQO: anyone at the recipient's company is on the opp. Contact SQO: the DM recipient IS the primary contact. A-SQOs ≥ C-SQOs always.
Tier Icons
🔥 High SQO rate (>1.25× avg)   ❌ Mailed but zero SQOs   ⚠️ Low SQO rate (<0.5× avg)
